_about: The Hardwood Bricks anchor desk: one AI anchor per school (Matthew's roster, Nov 14, 2026). Portraits are generated images on a green screen; tools/key_anchor.py keys them into anchors/<key>.webp. Every anchor is a fictional AI persona, disclosed as such in each video.
prompt: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 head-and-shoulders studio portrait of a {age} {gender_word} sports anchor, wearing a {colors_lower} {gear_desc} with '{SCHOOL}' {placement}. Clean studio broadcast lighting, centered framing from chest up, standing in front of a flat, evenly lit solid bright chroma-key green screen background with no green spill.
